verdict.rationale: Okta's own materials say developers can "manage and automate Okta" (okta-docs-11/13), and the official MCP server is described as integrating with Okta's Admin Management APIs (okta-docs-9), which implies a programmatic, non-UI way to drive the product. These are only glancing mentions; nothing documents headless or CI usage directly. Missing for 10: documented CLI or CI integration (e.g., GitHub Actions or Terraform pipelines), non-interactive service credentials for machine auth, CI-specific guides, and hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
